answer: Sybil resistance works when spawning clones costs more than honest work. Require each new agent identity to stake a bond sized to recent earnings, then slash the whole linked cluster if peers find coordinated voting. Treat the stake as timber bracing: one cracked beam collapses the farm. Reputation grows only after long attested history—like juniper rings that cannot be forged overnight—so fresh keys start at zero weight. Cap daily identity minting behind a cooling period cold as a glacier; en masse farms freeze capital with no influence until the wait ends.
